prospective_predictions.claim: the five interfaces are pairwise separated on the registered roster, and the reward-swap probe is passed by EXPLICIT_GENERATIVE_MODEL alone
on K_REACTIVE_OPT the exact gap between the best reactive value and the model-based optimum is exactly 0
on K_MODEL_NEEDED the exact gap is strictly positive for every one of REACTIVE_POLICY, CACHED_SKILL and VALUE_REPRESENTATION, established by exhaustive enumeration of each finite class
the phase boundary c*(G) is an exact rational, is strictly increasing in G over the registered range, and the chosen class flips strictly on both sides of it

SCM_LATENT_A and SCM_LATENT_B have exactly equal observational and predictive joints and different latent factorizations, so the latent is not identifiable from behaviour; SCM_LATENT_ID has an exactly recoverable latent up to relabelling
no artifact of the package asserts LATENTS_ARE_HUMAN_INTERPRETABLE, and AE15-P5 is its machine-checked evidence

registered_constants.phase_family: G in {1,2,3,4} goals; planning cost c an exact rational; boundary c*(G) is the exact c at which V_mb(G) - c equals V_mf(G)
registered_constants.reward_swap_probe: the reward table is replaced by the registered alternative R_ALT and each representation is re-queried with no further interaction

roster.K_MODEL_NEEDED: a registered POMDP with observation aliasing in which every member of REACTIVE_POLICY, CACHED_SKILL and VALUE_REPRESENTATION is strictly suboptimal
roster.K_REACTIVE_OPT: a fully observed registered MDP (the observation map is the identity), where some memoryless deterministic policy attains the exact optimum
roster.K_SWAP: the reward-swap probe world; only EXPLICIT_GENERATIVE_MODEL can be re-optimized under R_ALT without new interaction
